summary: Full backend REST + WebSocket real-time sync verified. Frontend E2E with 2 browser contexts confirms shared room, roster=2 on both clients, Live connection, and chat broadcast rendered on receiver. All 7 requested scenarios pass.
passed: POST /api/rooms/create returns 200 with 5-char code and persists room
GET /api/rooms/{code} returns room+items+chat (200) for existing code
WS /api/ws/{code} join -> init message with you/players/items/chat
Two WS clients in same room: joiner B sees A in players (count=2); A receives player_join + players events
WS move from A broadcast to B with updated x=500, dir=left
WS chat from A broadcast to B as 'chat' message and persisted (GET returns chat with 'hello world')
WS place broadcast to B and persisted; WS pickup broadcast to B and removes from DB (items count=0 after pickup)
Frontend: Lobby renders, Create My Island -> canvas loads, room-code-badge shows 5-char code, connection-status = Live
Frontend: Second browser context joins via code -> players-badge shows 2 on BOTH clients; Alice (A) and Bob (B) avatars visible on both
Frontend: Chat from A appears in B's chat log ('Alice: hi from alice')
notes: A transient 'WebSocket closed before established' console log appeared once on client B during Vite HMR handshake but WS reconnected and status went Live immediately; no functional impact. Movement sync visual verification was skipped on canvas (pixel-based) but backend WS move broadcast was verified end-to-end.
